Parking lot on the side road by the Main Athletic Field (대운동장 사잇길 주차장)
Temporary parking lot by the stream at the Main Gate (정문 천변 임시주차장)

From Main Gate Parking Payment Booth B (정문 B정산소) ~
three-way intersection in front of the College of Business Administration (경영대앞삼거리, near G9)
